name: flow-atelier-skills
description: Four plugins for Flow Atelier, autonomous project boards, time-bounded automatic goals, and brief-driven managed runs.

plugins.name: flow-atelier
plugins.description: General Flow Atelier operation: conduits, schedules, harnesses, and Claude consultations.

plugins.name: autonomous-projects
plugins.description: Operate the autonomous-projects conduit and project board.

plugins.name: automatic-goal
plugins.description: Operate outcome-driven goal runs, bounded review and repair, session reports, and a read-only local dashboard.

plugins.name: managing-managers
plugins.description: Write a queue of small briefs from a conversation and run them with a manager, workers and fresh reviewers, one pull request per brief.
